analysis.subject: Inquiry About Registration Fee and Submission Deadline
questions: Could you please confirm whether the registration fee for student authors is USD 350?
What is the full paper submission deadline?

reply.subject: Re: Inquiry About Registration Fee and Submission Deadline
reply.body:
Dear John Smith,

Thank you for your interest in ICCBDA 2027. We are pleased to confirm that the registration fee for student authors is USD 350.

The full paper submission deadline is February 15, 2027.

For your reference, ICCBDA 2027 is scheduled to take place on May 21-23, 2027, at Xihua University, Chengdu, China.

If you have any further questions, please contact the conference secretariat at iccbda2027@example.org.

Best regards,
Conference Secretariat
ICCBDA 2027
